intent.raw: create a project seed inside of domainspec core that is called autoads it uses @projects/ontologize/ and auto research and a creative development pipeline that create better creatives, by measuring outcomes from ad networks
intent.objective: Run the canonical refine loop to produce an MVP-ready, non-executed project seed for autoads: a creative-development pipeline that generates better ad creatives by measuring ad-network outcomes, built on the projects/ontologize ontology+DAG governed learning loop and an auto-research candidate component.
intent.operator_sentence: Create an autoads project seed that reuses ontologize and a creative pipeline that improves creatives by measuring ad-network outcomes.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ordinary refinement of a greenfield seed requires the canonical sequence with handoffs, validation, owner boundaries, and observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each stage produces a native receipt or blocked reason, handoffs carry frames/handles, and trace events group under the dispatch id.

technique_overlays.trigger: The central unknown is the pipeline architecture: creative generation, ad-network dispatch, outcome measurement, DAG promotion, and improved next-generation creatives.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Design names the pipeline components, flows, the ad-network evidence boundary, and the feedback loop back into creative generation.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several plausible pipeline shapes exist (per-network vs unified ontology axis, LLM-gen vs template-gen vs hybrid, online bandit vs batch promotion) and must be compared before planning.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Design records compared alternatives with selection criteria and a Pareto/convergence rationale; the selected unit recomposes into the ontologize loop.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ad-network outcome data is external and partly sensitive (spend, audience, possible PII) and must be routed through a fail-closed data-governance posture.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Design binds ad-network fields to ontologize's signed field-to-authority-class register with fail-closed routing; no real campaign data or credentials enter the seed.

route_menu.context_hint: Build the autoads seed on the ontologize ontology+DAG loop with an x-ray of the pipeline and a tournament over pipeline shapes. Alternatives are recorded; the selected route reuses ontologize rather than reinventing a learning loop.

items.label: Ontologize-grounded autoads seed
items.description: Define/Design/Plan autoads as a creative pipeline whose learning loop is the ontologize promotion DAG, with ad-network outcomes as events.

items.label: Standalone creative pipeline
items.description: Design autoads with its own bespoke metrics/learning loop. Rejected: duplicates a proven ontologize capability and loses governance/auditability.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Operator approved role-bound design fanout; the seed spans four distinct owner lanes that benefit from independent design.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The Design stage spans ontology reuse, the creative generation-measurement-improvement loop, ad-network outcome measurement plus data governance, and the auto-research component. Role-bound subagents mirror the ontologize research fanout and produce independent design artifacts the parent synthesizes.

roles.purpose: Map autoads onto ontologize's two-axis ontology and promotion DAG.
roles.owns: How creative families and audiences become ontology cards and how ad-network outcomes become DAG events/evidence/candidates.

roles.purpose: Design the generation -> dispatch -> measurement -> improvement loop.
roles.owns: Creative generation strategy, variant management, and the feedback path that turns measured outcomes into the next creative generation.

roles.purpose: Design the outcome schema, metric families, and ad-network data-governance posture.
roles.owns: Ad-network outcome ingestion, evidence-linked KPI families, veracidade grading, and the fail-closed field-to-authority-class register at the network edge.
How autoads researches new creative hypotheses/candidates automatically and feeds them into the generation stage as governed candidates.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirmed: spawn all 4 design subagents and collect receipts before synthesis.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the ontologize ontology+DAG baseline cannot be read.

steps.name: Invoke Define autoads
stop_conditions: Flag if the define lacks the unit of value or the ontologize binding.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review of the define
stop_conditions: Flag if the define overclaims a proven cross-vertical loop or omits the measurement edge.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Ask before external research; default is local ontologize/GoldenQuill evidence.

steps.name: Distill the coherent autoads unit
stop_conditions: Block if the unit cannot recompose into the ontologize promotion DAG.

steps.name: Invoke Design (role-bound fanout)
convergence_criteria: All four role receipts collected or a blocked reason recorded.
Pipeline components, ad-network evidence boundary, and feedback loop are named.
Selected pipeline shape recorded with a Pareto/convergence rationale.
stop_conditions: Block if a required role receipt is missing without a recorded blocked reason.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Flag if the data-governance posture or the feedback loop is underspecified.

steps.name: Distill repair of flagged gaps
stop_conditions: Block if a flagged design gap cannot be repaired or scoped to backlog.

steps.name: Invoke Plan (non-executed MVP plan)
stop_conditions: Block if the plan lacks a thin first slice with acceptance gates.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if done criteria in the seed proposal are not satisfied.

boundaries.contract: ontologize ontology+DAG method is read-only source precedent reused into autoads; no ontologize or GoldenQuill mutation occurs.
Ad-network outcomes enter only through a fail-closed field-to-authority-class register; no real credentials, spend, or PII enter the seed.

promotion_splits.rule: requires DAG review gates and owner decision; a metric is never authority on its own

gates.condition: Every runtime-backed stage names a canonical capability handle and records a receipt or blocked reason.
All four design role receipts are collected or carry an explicit blocked reason before synthesis.
ontologize and GoldenQuill are read-only precedent; this run writes only under projects/autoads.
Ad-network outcome handling routes through a fail-closed authority-class register; no real credentials or PII in the seed.
Design names generation, dispatch, measurement, promotion, and the feedback loop back into generation, plus the auto-research component.
Every product capability claim is labeled [SB], [adapt], or [H].
Outputs are a candidate seed; no canonical promotion, no pricing/contracts/named clients, no executed pipeline.
RESULT.md confirms DEFINE, DESIGN, PLAN exist with a thin first slice and acceptance gates.

promotion_guardrails: ontologize and GoldenQuill remain read-only source precedent.
Measured ad-network outcomes are candidate evidence until DAG review gates plus owner decision.
No canonical Arcanum promotion; no pricing/contracts/named clients; no executed pipeline or live ad-network calls.
